title: GDS Releases 2025 Sustainability Report, Achieving MSCI AAA Rating
author: Gds Holdings Limited
description: GDS Holdings announced significant sustainability progress in its 2025 report, raising renewable energy usage to 60%, improving PUE to 1.23, and achieving a 23.1% reduction in carbon intensity. The company upgraded its MSCI ESG rating to AAA (highest tier), maintained its CDP B rating, and retained its Moody's NZA-2 net-zero assessment, remaining the only data center company globally to pass this certification. GDS also launched China's first recycled cooking oil biodiesel program and achieved Zero Waste to Landfill certification at its Shanghai facility.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Company demonstrated exceptional sustainability performance with upgraded MSCI ESG rating to AAA (highest tier), significant improvements in renewable energy usage (60%), carbon intensity reduction (23.1%), and innovative circular economy initiatives. Achievement of Moody's NZA-2 net-zero assessment as the only data center company globally to pass validates strong environmental governance and implementation.

title: Triata Capital Dumps Nearly 2M Shares of This AI Stock
author: Dave Kovaleski
description: Triata Capital significantly reduced its stake in GDS Holdings by selling 1.89 million shares for approximately $80.89 million in Q1 2026, cutting its position from 12.6% to 7.94% of AUM. The fund's decision to take profits came after GDS stock nearly doubled from $24 to $48 per share, though the company reported strong Q1 results with 24% revenue growth and surging EBITDA margins.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Mixed signals: strong Q1 fundamentals (24% YoY revenue growth, 247% net income increase, 57.9% EBITDA margin) and maintained guidance are positive, but the large institutional selloff and high valuation (forward P/E of 64) suggest concerns about overvaluation. The stock has since declined from $45.70 to $35.14, indicating profit-taking by sophisticated investors.

title: GDS Stock Falls Despite Q1 Beat As Guidance Trails Estimates
author: Lekha Gupta
description: GDS Holdings reported strong Q1 2026 results with revenue of $488.1M (23.6% YoY growth) and EPS of $1.53, both exceeding expectations. The company achieved record quarterly bookings of 200MW driven by AI data center demand. However, shares fell 6.41% as management reiterated full-year 2026 guidance of $1.749-$1.819B in revenue, below the consensus estimate of $1.90B.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Despite beating Q1 earnings expectations with strong revenue growth (23.6% YoY) and record quarterly bookings of 200MW, the stock declined 6.41% due to management reiterating full-year revenue guidance of $1.749-$1.819B, which trails the consensus estimate of $1.90B. The miss on forward guidance outweighed the positive quarterly results.

title: Hedge Fund Adds 1.9 Million Shares of Utility Stock, According to Latest SEC Filing
author: Jake Lerch
description: 12 West Capital Management LP established a new position in Hawaiian Electric Industries, acquiring 1.85 million shares valued at approximately $22.75 million in Q4 2025. The investment represents 2.71% of the fund's assets under management. Hawaiian Electric has gained 29.9% over the past year, driven by increased electricity demand from AI data centers, though recent headwinds from opposition to data center development have caused share pullbacks.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Hedge fund initiated a significant new position with 1.85M shares, indicating institutional confidence. Stock has appreciated 29.9% over the past year driven by AI data center demand. However, sentiment is tempered by recent pullbacks due to growing opposition to data center development and environmental concerns.

title: GDS to Report Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Financial Results Before the Open of the U.S. Market on March 17, 2026
author: Gds Holdings Limited
description: GDS Holdings Limited announced it will report its fourth quarter and full year 2025 financial results on March 17, 2026, with an earnings conference call scheduled for 8:00 AM U.S. Eastern Time. The company is a leading developer and operator of high-performance data centers in China serving hyperscale cloud providers, internet companies, and financial institutions.
